name: How long does kitchen finish carpentry typically take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen finish carpentry typically take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard kitchens typically require two to five working days for finish carpentry, depending on the scope of work. Installing basic base and upper wall cabinets along with simple baseboards usually takes two to three days. Projects that include complex features—such as custom pantries, kitchen island wrapping, decorative range hood covers, stacked crown moldings, and scribing to uneven historic plaster—can extend the schedule to a full week. Clear access to the space, pre-delivered materials, and completed rough plumbing and electrical rough-ins prevent unexpected downtime during this stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard kitchen finish carpentry projects take between two and five days, while intricate trim packages, islands, and custom millwork can take a full week.
